goal: Add per-client rate limiting to the public HTTP API, configurable per route, with metrics and documentation.

tasks.title: Token-bucket limiter
tasks.description: Implement a thread-safe token-bucket rate limiter keyed by client id, with injectable clock, in src/ratelimit/. No framework dependencies.
acceptance: TokenBucket(capacity, refill_per_s, clock) allows exactly `capacity` requests in a burst
Tokens refill continuously at refill_per_s and never exceed capacity
Concurrent acquire() from 16 threads never over-admits (test included)

tasks.title: Rate-limit settings
tasks.description: Add typed per-route rate-limit settings (capacity, refill rate, burst override) loaded from the existing settings module, with defaults that preserve current behaviour.
acceptance: Settings validate capacity >= 1 and refill > 0, with clear errors
Tests cover defaults, overrides and invalid values

tasks.title: HTTP middleware
tasks.description: Enforce the limiter in the API middleware chain: identify the client, look up the route's settings, reject over-limit requests with 429 and a Retry-After header.
acceptance: Over-limit requests get 429 with an integer Retry-After header
Integration tests cover allowed, limited and recovered clients

tasks.title: Metrics
tasks.description: Export counters for allowed and rejected requests per route and a gauge of active buckets.
acceptance: ratelimit_active_buckets reports the live bucket count
Tests assert metric values after a scripted burst

tasks.title: Operator documentation
tasks.description: Document how rate limiting works, how to configure it per route, what clients see when limited, and which metrics to alert on.
acceptance: docs/rate-limiting.md covers configuration, client behaviour and metrics
Every setting name matches the code
